def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call.

    Implements the Toolformer API-call loss-filter procedure (T01-T05).
    """
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights for future tokens (T01)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * np.arange(horizon))
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        # Fallback: uniform weights (should not happen for positive horizon)
        normalized_weights = np.ones(horizon) / horizon
    else:
        normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted negative log probabilities (T02)
    weighted_loss_with = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    weighted_loss_call = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    weighted_loss_no = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)

    # Use the stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(weighted_loss_no, weighted_loss_call)

    # Keep calls that meet the filtering threshold (T04)
    margins = L_minus - weighted_loss_with
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
